name: Line-art reveal then fill
visual_intent: Progressive illustration: strokes draw in reading order, then flat fills fade in under them.
implementation_summary: Collects stroked shapes in a group, orders them (document, left-right, top-down), draws at pen speed, then fades [data-fill] shapes.

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/test-studio-runtime.py and frame review of projects/masala-chai-recipe (landscape, portrait, square) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
